notes_for_editor: Two tower listings give the name, county, agency and coordinates; neither gives a build date, design, height or status. NCpedia's Air Bellows Gap and Airbellows community share the name; the story does not link the tower to them and no source read does. A Parkway overlook at milepost 236.9 appeared only in a search snippet and is not used. The record's agency field was null; the Forest Lookouts page supplies it. Record kind 'tower' is consistent with the tnlandforms list.
